autoContext: Generates a complete, applyable Terraform repo for an ECS Fargate cluster/service/task-definition behind an ALB, scoped to an EXISTING VPC and subnets supplied at intake. CREATION pattern: intake -> render -> apply -> verify -> postread.

intake.prompt: Workspace-relative output directory for the generated repo (e.g. infra/ecs-cluster):
Project/environment name to prefix resource names (e.g. acme-prod):
Existing VPC id to deploy into (e.g. vpc-0abc123). This workflow does not create a VPC:
Comma-separated existing subnet ids for the ALB and ECS tasks (at least two, in different AZs):
Container image to run, including tag (e.g. 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/acme-api:latest):
Container port the app listens on (e.g. 8080):
Fargate task size as "cpu,memory" in the AWS-valid combinations (e.g. 256,512):
